title: Pride and Prejudice
author: Jane Austen
summary: Elizabeth Bennet meets the proud Mr. Darcy in this sharp and witty classic about first impressions, family, and love in Regency England.

title: The Time Machine
author: H. G. Wells
summary: A Victorian inventor travels hundreds of thousands of years into the future and discovers what has become of humanity.

title: Frankenstein
author: Mary Shelley
summary: Young scientist Victor Frankenstein creates life and must face the consequences of his ambition in this founding work of science fiction.

title: The Lantern Keeper
author: Yusuf Kareem
summary: In a quiet port town, an old lighthouse keeper and a curious girl uncover letters that change how the whole town remembers its past.

title: On the Origin of Species
author: Charles Darwin
summary: Darwin's landmark explanation of natural selection, written for general readers and still one of the most influential science books ever published.

title: The Quiet Ocean
author: Maya Torres
summary: A marine biologist takes readers into the deep sea to explain how ocean currents, plankton, and whales keep our planet alive.

title: Systems Thinking for Busy Students
author: Adam Brooks
summary: Short chapters and clear diagrams show how feedback loops, delays, and stocks explain everything from traffic jams to climate.

title: Clean Steps: A Beginner's Guide to Software Design
author: Lina Haddad
summary: Learn how to write code that is easy to read, test, and change, with small practical examples and checklists for student projects.

title: Data Structures in Plain English
author: Omar Farouk
summary: Arrays, lists, trees, hash tables, and graphs explained with everyday analogies before any code appears.

title: The Agile Classroom
author: Rania Mansour
summary: How student teams can plan sprints, run stand-ups, and deliver working software step by step without losing track of quality.

title: The Wealth of Nations
author: Adam Smith
summary: The classic study of markets, trade, and the division of labour that shaped modern economics.

title: Start Lean, Grow Smart
author: Hana Al-Mutairi
summary: A practical guide for first-time founders in the Gulf region: testing ideas cheaply, finding customers, and growing with care.

title: The Art of War
author: Sun Tzu
summary: An ancient text on strategy and planning, now read widely for lessons on leadership, competition, and decision making.

title: Deserts of Light: Trade Routes of Arabia
author: Khalid Al-Saeed
summary: Follow incense, spice, and pilgrim caravans across the Arabian Peninsula and discover the towns that grew along the way.

title: The Silk Notebook
author: Amina Rahman
summary: Stories of merchants, scholars, and translators who carried knowledge between East and West along the Silk Road.

title: Meditations
author: Marcus Aurelius
summary: Private notes of a Roman emperor on patience, duty, and calm, still read today as a guide to a steady mind.

title: Small Habits, Big Days
author: Daniel Reed
summary: Simple daily routines for better focus, sleep, and study, backed by easy experiments you can try this week.

title: Alice's Adventures in Wonderland
author: Lewis Carroll
summary: Alice follows a White Rabbit down a hole into a world of riddles, tea parties, and a very bad-tempered queen.

title: Treasure Island
author: Robert Louis Stevenson
summary: Young Jim Hawkins sails with pirates in search of buried gold in this famous adventure story.

title: Stars Over Riyadh
author: Sara Nasser
summary: A bedtime picture book about a boy and his grandfather who name the desert stars on a camping night.
